name: What immediate steps should I take inside my home after severe storm damage?

mainEntity.name: What immediate steps should I take inside my home after severe storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The immediate priority is ensuring personal safety and preventing further water or structural intrusion. Turn off your main electrical breaker if water is entering near outlets or ceiling fixtures, and avoid walking through standing water. Take clear photos and videos of the damage, including buckled drywall, soaked flooring, or compromised ceilings, before touching anything. Once documentation is complete, contact a licensed contractor to secure the area and arrange an inspection. HH Remodeling can help evaluate interior structural framing, cut away saturated drywall, and protect the home from secondary deterioration while you coordinate with your insurer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Shut off power near leaks, document all damage with photos and video, avoid standing water, and call a contractor to stabilize framing and remove water-soaked drywall.
